_comment: Two wrong senses in the sidebar. token_elevation used 代幣 -- the coin sense, as in an arcade or cryptocurrency token -- rather than the security-credential sense; aligned to 令牌, this pack's own majority for security tokens (81 leaves against 代幣's 9). credentials used 證書, which means a certificate or diploma; for a privileged-access product 'Credentials' means the stored account secrets, and this same pack already renders it correctly as 認證資料 in components:sectionLanding.group.credentials, so the sidebar and the section landing disagreed with each other. Aligned to the correct one. AGENT DRAFTS -- native review still required.
